fusions.name: Wrist-Lock Twist
fusions.desc: Grabs the target and twists, dealing 13 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Wind-Up
fusions.desc: Grips your weapon in both fists and spins a full turn, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Crank the Handle
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rung Over Rung
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
